jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Developer to join our dynamic Digital and Data team at Public Health Wales. You’ll play a key role in developing and delivering high\-quality digital solutions that support national health services. Working closely with senior technical leads and your team, you’ll contribute to designing, building, and maintaining systems that improve digital health services in Wales. It’s a great time to join us as we’re adopting new technologies and growing our technical professions.
  
  

The role sits within the Research, Data and Digital Directorate and contributes directly to the organisation’s strategic goals. You’ll work closely with cross\-functional teams, senior leaders, and external partners to help shape effective, future\-ready services across the health system.
  
  

If you're passionate about crafting solutions with population\-level impact —this is your opportunity to make a real difference.
  
  

**Occupation Code:** 2134, Programmers and software development professionals.
  
  

Overseas candidates will need to check they are eligible before applying for the post.
  
  

Contribute to the design, build, integration, and maintenance of scalable, secure, and interoperable software systems.
  
  

Develop and maintain code under guidance, following established standards and best practices.
  
  

Collaborate with team members and stakeholders to ensure systems meet technical, clinical, and business standards.
  
  

Apply agile and user\-centred development practices and collaborating with diverse teams.
  
  

Follow data protection, cyber security, and national digital infrastructure standards in all development and maintenance activities.
  
  

Support the maintenance of service components, assist with troubleshooting issues, and help ensure systems perform reliably.
  
  

For further information on Public Health Wales please visit https://phw.nhs.wales/
  
  

We are Public Health Wales – the national public health agency in Wales. Our purpose is ‘ Working together for a healthier Wales' . We exist to help everyone in Wales live longer, healthier, happier lives. Together with our partners, we work to increase healthy life expectancy, improve health and well\-being, and reduce inequalities for everyone in Wales, now and for future generations.
  
  

Our teams work to prevent disease, protect health, and provide leadership, specialist services and public health expertise. We are the leading source of public health information, research and innovation in Wales. In a world facing complex health challenges, our work has never been so important.
  
  

We are guided by our Values, 'Working together, with trust and respect, to make a difference'. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace that values equality and diversity. We welcome applications which represent the rich diversity of the communities we serve and are supportive of flexible working arrangements, including part time roles and job sharing.
  
  

To find out more about working for us and the benefits we offer please visit https://phw.nhs.wales/careers/
  
  

For guidance on the application process, please visit https://phw.nhs.wales/working\-for\-us/applicant\-information\-and\-guidance/
  
  

Join Public Health Wales as a Developer and play a pivotal role in transforming how we deliver digital and data services across the organisation.
  
  

As a Developer, you will help deliver robust digital solutions that support Public Health Wales’ goals. Working with product owners, architects, and user researchers, you’ll ensure systems are user\-focused and meet high standards, while contributing to best practices and continuous improvement.
  
  

What You’ll Do
  
  

Support development activities from concept to deployment, ensuring quality and timely delivery.
  
  

Use modern development tools and standards (e.g., .NET, C\#, SQL, Docker, Azure) to build and maintain high\-quality solutions.
  
  

Participate in code reviews, contribute to test automation, and follow high coding standards.
  
  

Contribute to designing secure systems and follow processes for DPIA and cyber security assessments.
  
  

Contribute to technical discussions with team members, NHS partners and suppliers, supporting collaboration and sharing expertise.
  
  

Share knowledge and provide support to colleagues, helping promote best practices and team development.
  
  

What You Bring
  
  

Experience of contributing to development teams and delivering complex digital solutions.
  
  

Foundational knowledge in software development, cloud platforms, DevOps, and microservices.
  
  

Good communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non\-specialist audiences.
  
  

A collaborative mindset, with a commitment to supporting colleagues and continuous learning.
  
  

**Desirable:** Professional certifications (e.g., Microsoft, Scrum), experience with Blazor, Python, or Java.
  
  

A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field.
  
  

The ability to speak Welsh is desirable for this post; Welsh and/or English speakers are equally welcome.
  
  

Interviews 15\-16th October .
  
  

You will be able to find a full Job description and Person Specification attached within the supporting documents or please click “Apply now” to view in Trac.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Software Engineer**


Luton \| Full\-time \| Hybrid


20% bonus • 7% pension • Staff travel benefits


We support hybrid working, and you’ll spend 60% of your time each month in the office.

 **You're a hands\-on software engineer who enjoys solving real\-world problems and building technology that makes a difference.**


You combine strong engineering fundamentals with curiosity, ownership and a passion for continuous learning. Whether you're designing cloud\-native applications, improving engineering quality or exploring AI\-assisted development tools, you'll thrive in an environment where collaboration and innovation are encouraged every day.

**The opportunity**


As a Software Engineer, you'll help build, deliver and operate technology solutions that support one of Europe's leading airlines. Working within an agile engineering squad, you'll collaborate with Product Owners, Engineering Managers and fellow engineers to turn business priorities into reliable, scalable software solutions.


This is a hands\-on role where you'll contribute across the full software development lifecycle, from design and development through to testing, deployment and operational support. You'll take ownership of well\-defined technical challenges, contribute to technical discussions and continue developing your engineering expertise with support from experienced colleagues.

 ***"The best engineers in our teams are curious, collaborative and passionate about building great software. You'll have the opportunity to work with modern technologies, solve meaningful problems and contribute to systems that operate at scale across the airline."*** Head of Software Engineering

 **The team \& culture**


You'll join one of our Engineering squads, working alongside software engineers, product specialists and technology leaders to deliver products and services used by customers and colleagues across easyJet.


Our teams value learning, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. You'll be encouraged to contribute ideas, develop your technical capability and work with modern engineering practices and technologies in a supportive and collaborative environment.

**What you’ll be doing**

* Design, build, test, deploy and support production software.
* Develop high\-quality, maintainable and well\-tested code.
* Build and support applications using AWS, .NET and Java technologies.
* Contribute to technical design discussions and implementation activities.
* Investigate defects, troubleshoot issues and support production systems.
* Improve software quality through code reviews, testing, observability and reliability practices.
* Collaborate with product, design and engineering colleagues to deliver valuable solutions.
* Contribute to engineering practices including CI/CD, automated testing and release management.
* Use AI\-assisted engineering tools thoughtfully to improve development effectiveness and software quality.

**What we’re looking for**

* Commercial software engineering experience within a modern technology environment.
* Strong experience developing applications using .NET and/or Java.
* Experience building and supporting cloud\-native applications on AWS.
* Experience working with APIs, distributed systems and modern software architectures.
* Confidence working with shared codebases, automated testing and code review processes.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control and cloud\-based development workflows.
* Strong debugging, analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* A growth mindset and enthusiasm for learning new technologies and approaches.
* Interest in AI\-assisted engineering tools and emerging software development practices.


Desirable experience includes working within regulated or operationally complex environments, particularly airlines, airports or other high\-availability industries, as well as experience with Kubernetes, Docker and AWS serverless technologies.

**What you’ll get**


\> \> Competitive base salary \+ up to 20% bonus


\> \> 7% employer pension contribution


\> \> Private medical insurance


\> \> 25 days holiday \+ bank holidays


\> \> Annual credit towards an easyJet holiday


\> \> Excellent staff travel benefits


\> \> Flexible benefits package including share schemes

 **Diversity isn't a checkbox — it's how we fly**


Great technology comes from diverse thinking and different perspectives. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences. Whatever your path into software engineering, we're interested in the skills, curiosity and potential you'll bring to the team.

**Reasonable Adjustments**


At easyJet, we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace that reflects the diverse customers we serve across Europe. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds. If you require specific adjustments or support during the application or recruitment process, such as extra time for assessments or accessible interview locations, please contact us at ma.recruitment@easyjet.com. We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process to ensure accessibility and accommodation.

 **Ready to lead for customers when it matters most? Apply now.**

**Requirements of the Role**
----------------------------

  

.

* A passion for continuously improving engineering quality, standards and ways of working.
* It would be beneficial if you also have experience of:

* Developer tooling, build pipelines and engineering enablement.

**What you’ll get**


\> \> Competitive base salary \+ up to 20% bonus


\> \> 7% employer pension contribution


\> \> Private medical insurance


\> \> 25 days holiday \+ bank holidays


\> \> Annual credit towards an easyJet holiday


\> \> Excellent staff travel benefits


\> \> Flexible benefits package including share schemes

 **Diversity isn't a checkbox — it's how we fly**


Great engineering teams benefit from different perspectives, experiences and ways of thinking. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and are committed to creating an environment where everyone can contribute, grow and succeed.

**Reasonable Adjustments**


At easyJet, we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace that reflects the diverse customers we serve across Europe. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds. If you require specific adjustments or support during the application or recruitment process, such as extra time for assessments or accessible interview locations, please contact us at ma.recruitment@easyjet.com. We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process to ensure accessibility and accommodation.

jobs.title: Electro-Bio Medical Engineering (EBME) Assistant
jobs.description:
**About the role**


Interested in developing your engineering career in a role that combines problem\-solving, technology and practical hands\-on work?


Join the **Electro\-Bio\-Medical Engineering (EBME)** team at **Nobles Hospital** and play an important role in keeping a diverse range of medical equipment safe, reliable and ready for use. Working across healthcare facilities, you'll carry out inspections, repairs, testing and planned maintenance on equipment ranging from patient beds and pressure\-relieving devices to respiratory and oxygen equipment, helping to support the delivery of essential healthcare services across the Island.


We're looking for a motivated individual with a background in an electrical, electronic or mechanical discipline who enjoys problem\-solving and takes pride in delivering high\-quality work. This is an excellent opportunity to build a long\-term technical career, with a structured development pathway that includes continued professional development, vocational training and on\-the\-job learning. As part of a small, dedicated team, you'll work independently as well as alongside colleagues, taking ownership of tasks both within the hospital and across a range of sites while developing the skills needed to progress to EBME Technician and Senior EBME Technician levels.


Take the next step in your engineering career and apply today to help keep vital healthcare equipment operating safely and effectively across our health services.

**A workplace that invests in you**

A competitive salary that increases each 12 months until you reach the salary maximum.


Annual leave starting from 21 days, a Privilege Day and 10 Bank Holidays; your annual leave will increase after your first year and again after your third year.


Subject to meeting eligibility criteria, the IOM Public Service offers two pension arrangements: the Isle of Man Government Unified Scheme 2011 or the Isle of Man Government Defined Contribution (DC) Arrangement.


Access to the Learning, Education and Development training facility, which is exclusively for Public Service employees, to keep on top of your continuous professional development.

Discounted access to the NSC gym and island swimming pools as well as 1\-to\-1 support programmes and exercise classes with qualified instructors.


Free access to the Isle of Man Government Staff Welfare Service which offers professional counselling, emotional support and signposting on a wide range of issues.

Ability to apply for an unpaid career break after 3 years’ service.


Access to the Isle of Man Public Service Cycle to Work scheme after your first year of employment.


Access to the Noble’s Hospital staff canteen where you can purchase affordable meals, drinks and snacks.


Free car parking.


**Working for the Isle of Man Public Service**


We are the largest employer on the island delivering a diverse range of services to the people of the Isle of Man. We care, nurture and value our employees’ wellbeing, development and career and place great importance on rewarding the commitment by our wonderful employees.


We support and promote flexible working, recognising the importance of working flexibly around your life and commitments and the benefits in improving work\-life balance. We are happy to discuss flexible working arrangements where possible and if interested you should discuss this with the Recruiting Manager.


The Isle of Man Public Service is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates equality, diversity and inclusion. We understand how a wide range of views and experiences can benefit us as we work together for the Isle of Man.


Your candidate experience is important to us. As a proud member of The Circle Back Initiative, we commit to respond to every applicant that applies for an Isle of Man Public Service role.


We are committed to net zero by 2050 and as an entire nation UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, we are transforming public services for a sustainable future and your contributions will directly benefit our community, economy, and environment.


**Things to note**


A standard police check is required for this post, the cost of which will be covered by the Isle of Man Government.


Please note a relocation package is not available for this role.


**Ready to apply?**


We understand that you might have some questions about the role and the Recruiting Manager is on hand to support you. You can contact them at mark.higgins@gov.im.


To get the best out of your application, read our article on the important essentials you need to know before applying.


Applications will be accepted up to midnight of the closing date specified. If you have difficulties applying online, please contact us on 01624 685000 or by email at helpmeapply@gov.im.

jobs.title: 259544 Software Systems Designer and Developer
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy solving complex technical challenges and developing systems that make a real difference to patient care?


NHS Dumfries \& Galloway is looking for a Software Systems Designer \& Developer to join our Applications \& Development Team. This role offers the opportunity to design, develop, implement and support software solutions and system integrations that underpin the delivery of healthcare services across the region.


You'll work on a diverse portfolio of clinical and corporate systems, supporting everything from patient\-facing applications and clinical systems to integration platforms and reporting solutions. The role involves software development, systems integration, database administration, project delivery, supplier engagement, and supporting the ongoing digital transformation of NHS services.


This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys variety and wants to work with a wide range of technologies including:

* Microsoft SQL Server
* InterSystems Ensemble / Health Connect
* HL7 Messaging \& Interoperability
* Cache ObjectScript
* .NET Development
* Web Technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, ASP.NET)
* Windows and Linux Server Platforms
* Database Design and Administration


Working closely with clinicians, managers, system suppliers and national NHS teams, you will play a key role in delivering reliable and innovative digital solutions that support patient care and operational services across Dumfries \& Galloway.


We are looking for someone with:

* Experience of software design, development and implementation
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Database administration experience
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills
* The ability to manage multiple priorities and projects
* Experience working with system integrations, interfaces or healthcare systems would be advantageous

**Why Join NHS Dumfries \& Galloway?**


Our Development Team provides a critical service supporting a wide range of strategic clinical systems. You'll work alongside experienced developers, application specialists and integration professionals in a collaborative environment where your work has a direct impact on healthcare delivery.

**We offer:**

* Flexible and supportive working arrangements
* Access to a diverse technology estate
* Opportunities to develop specialist technical skills
* Involvement in local and national digital health initiatives
* NHS Pension Scheme and employee benefits package


If you are looking for a role where you can combine software development, systems design, integration and project delivery while contributing to the improvement of healthcare services, we would love to hear from you.

**For an informal discussion about the post, please contact Kerry Aldridge on Kerry.aldridge2@nhs.scot**


If you require a Work Visa, please check to see if you and the vacancy you are applying for are eligible by visiting the Home Office website: https://www.gov.uk/check\-uk\-visa

### **INFORMATION FOR ALL CANDIDATES**

**To find out more about working with NHS Dumfries and Galloway and for an insight into our friendly, beautiful corner of Scotland please visit our Work With Us web pages** **https://www.nhsdg.co.uk/workwithus/**  

  

**APPLICATION PROCESS** **\-** https://www.careers.nhs.scot/how\-to\-apply/application\-process/


Please note that our correspondence method is by e\-mail, therefore please ensure you enter your email address accurately. Please check your e\-mail regularly (including junk folders) and also your Jobtrain account for updates.


Please contact Jobtrain Candidate Support Hub \- https://jobseekersupport.jobtrain.co.uk/support/home for advice and support with any system issues.

* **Accessing Jobtrain** \- Users may experience issues if accessing Jobtrain via mobile phone, we recommend using a computer, laptop or tablet.
* **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** \- Tools like ChatGPT or Copilot can be helpful when planning or preparing your applicationbut your responses must be written by you.  

Be authentic: Your application should genuinely reflect your own skills, experience, and motivations.  

Use AI appropriately: It’s fine to use AI for inspiration or to check spelling and grammar, but it shouldn’t write your answers for you.  

Why this matters: Applications that appear to rely on AIgenerated content may be withdrawn. By applying, you confirm that your answers are based on your personal knowledge and achievements.  

Tip: Think of AI as a support tool, not a replacement. We want to understand you, not an AI\-generated version of you.
* **CVs \-** DO NOT upload a CV as this will not be used for shortlisting purposes.
* **Assessment Form \-** Within the application you are required to answer three questions giving you the opportunity to fully evidence why you are the ideal person for the job. Please ensure these statements are written by yourself and are unique to you. This section times out after 30 minutes. A tip is to build your reply on a Word document and copy and paste into Jobtrain. If you exceed the maximum amount of characters it will cut your text at this point, please check your information once copied and pasted.
* Once you have submitted your application form you will be unable to make any amendments.
* Posts close at midnight on the indicated date however **please be aware that a vacancy may close early due to volume of applications, therefore you should not delay in submitting your application.**
* If you are a member of staff please ensure you update your Jobtrain profile to reflect that you are employed by NHS Dumfries and Galloway.
* Staff and patients across Dumfries and Galloway enjoy free, unlimited parking at all our hospital sites.

 **DISCLOSURE SCOTLAND** Some of our posts may require you to undergo a criminal records check. Changes as of the 1 April 2025 to the Protection of Vulnerable Groups (PVG) scheme membership now sees more roles requiring PVG that may not have needed this check in the past. If you are successful in this role you will be notified which level of check is required by the recruitment team. If you would like to read more information please visit: Disclosure levels \- mygov.scot

**EQUALITY AND DIVERSITY**  

NHS Dumfries and Galloway is committed to encouraging equality and diversity among our workforce, and eliminating unlawful discrimination. The aim is for our workforce to be truly representative and for each employee to feel respected and able to give their best. To this end, NHS Dumfries and Galloway welcomes applicants from all sections of the community.

**PUBLIC PROTECTION**  

Public protection practice encompasses the recognition and management of risk in order to prevent or reduce harm to children, (including unborn babies), young people and adults. All public protection legislation, and NHS Dumfries and Galloway (NHSDG) policies and guidance are founded on the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child and the European Convention on Human Rights, and the principles of these Conventions underpin all NHSDG core business.

**ADDITIONAL INFORMATION FOR INTERNATIONAL CANDIDATES**
-------------------------------------------------------

**RIGHT TO WORK IN THE UNITED KINGDOM**  

NHS Dumfries and Galloway has a legal obligation to ensure that it does not employ any worker who has not been granted the relevant permission to work in the UK. This permission is without exception granted by the UK Border Agency. We are required to check the entitlement to work in the UK of all prospective employees, regardless of nationality or job category.


**WORK VISA**  

If you require a Work Visa, please check to see if you and the vacancy you are applying for are eligible by visiting the Home Office website: https://www.gov.uk/check\-uk\-visa  

**It is ESSENTIAL that you have checked that you either already have an appropriate right to work in the UK or if you require a work visa that the post would be eligible to be sponsoredBEFORE submitting your application form. We are unable to provide sponsorship for bank contracts.**

**UNITED KINGDOM REGISTRATION**  

NHS Dumfries \& Galloway are unable to support OSCE Training for international nurses for vacancies.  

Vacancies requiring professional registration **require full United Kingdom registration** with the appropriate council (eg NMC, HCPC, GMC, GDC etc).

jobs.title: Internship C# Developer
jobs.description:
**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Societe Generale Global Solution Centre (SG GSC)** acts as a business solution center for Societe Generale, one of the largest European financial groups. We provide high\-quality professional services for more than 35 countries in various fields of activity – Finance \& Accounting, HR, IT and Corporate Operations. Our mission is to be a partner of choice, valued for owning, transforming and innovating through best in class talent. IT Filiere is part of the Centre and comprises four Perimeters: Retail Banking, Security and Infrastructure, Internal Support Applications and Investment Banking, with a total of more than 800 IT professionals.


Our application is used for the management of collateral. It’s used by front office and middle office and provides different services: collateral exposure computation, security eligibility service to collateralization, optimization of movement on collateral proposal, middle office workflow to manage collateral with counterparts. In the same time, the application is key for MARK financing pre\-trade and collateral workflow.


Specifically, you will be required to:


* Contribute to the design, development and testing of new features under the guidance of senior engineers as part of an Agile/Scrum team;

* Participate in the implementation and maintenance of backend services and user\-facing applications using C\# and .NET technologies;

* Learn and apply software engineering best practices, including clean code, code reviews, automated testing and secure development principles;

* Assist in troubleshooting, debugging and resolving application issues across development, testing and production environments;

* Collaborate with business analysts, developers and support teams to understand requirements and deliver high\-quality solutions;

* Contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes, tooling and CI/CD pipelines;

* Create and maintain technical documentation related to implemented features and development activities;

* Take ownership of assigned tasks while actively learning from experienced team members and expanding technical knowledge.
**Profile required**
--------------------

* Final\-year Bachelor's or Master's student in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Informatics or a related field.

* Good understanding of programming fundamentals, algorithms, data structures and object\-oriented design principles.

* Basic knowledge of C\#, .NET, Angular/AngularJS and relational databases (SQL Server knowledge is a plus).

* Familiarity with web technologies, REST APIs and JSON.

* Eagerness to learn modern software development practices, including microservices, automated testing, CI/CD and cloud\-native architectures.

* Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.

* Interest in software quality practices and development tools such as NUnit, SonarQube and Jenkins (or similar CI/CD platforms).

* Previous academic, personal or internship projects involving software development are considered a plus.

* Good command of English, both written and spoken, with the ability to collaborate effectively in an international environment. French is a plus.

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with attention to detail.

* Curious, proactive and motivated to continuously learn and develop technical skills.

* Team player with good communication skills and the ability to work effectively within Agile/Scrum teams.

* Interest in AI\-assisted software development tools and modern engineering practices.

* Ability to critically review, understand, test and improve code generated by AI coding assistants.

* Strong focus on software engineering fundamentals, including code quality, maintainability, debugging and problem\-solving.

* Ability to validate solutions through analysis, testing and reasoning rather than relying solely on generated code.
**Why join us**
---------------

Plus, you will enjoy all our benefits **:**

* competitive compensation \& remuneration, including annual performance bonus;
* preventive healthcare plan, and group health \& life insurance;
* wide range of flexible benefits within a monthly budget;
* office perks, wellbeing and mental health programs;
* various social benefits and bonuses for personal or family events;
* 9\-to\-5 workday \& flexible (hybrid) work environment;
* additional paid and unpaid time off, including Sabbatical leave;
* learning and growth opportunities based on individual development and career plans;
* unlimited access to various eLearning resources
**Business insight**

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer - Pensions and Spend
jobs.description:
Senior Product Engineer - Investments

About Kota

Kota is reimagining insurance and retirement benefits for the modern workforce. Through our two flagship products - Kota Platform, the first fully integrated benefits platform, and Kota Embed, our embedded insurance solution - we're making benefits more accessible, valued, and global.

Today, we power benefits for tens of thousands of employees at Europe's most forward-thinking companies, including Carwow, Tines, Zoe, and Remote. Founded in 2022, we've raised more than €20M from leading investors such as EQT Ventures, Eurazeo, Northzone, and Frontline, as well as founders and executives from Workday, Remote, Personio, OpenAI, and more.

The role & team

We're looking for a Senior Product Engineer to join the Investments team, building the product that powers workplace pensions, retirement savings and our spend product at Kota. It's a full stack role with a backend lean, your strongest expertise will be backend and you'll work in the frontend when the product needs it.

The Investments team owns more than pensions. On one side, pension infrastructure is genuinely complex: multi-provider, multi-market and largely unmodernised. You'll design the systems that connect pension providers to employers and employees, covering contributions, fund data, payroll integrations and compliance across multiple markets.

On the other hand, you'll own our Spend product. This lets employers create allowances and issue cards to employees, who get a virtual Stripe card they can add to Apple or Google Wallet and spend in real time. It spans card issuing, wallet provisioning, transaction flows and the controls employers need to manage it. We want someone who starts with the customer, not the code, and proactively adds to the roadmap rather than just picking up tickets. This is an autonomous role, you'll be trusted to make product calls, not just technical ones.

What You'll Do

Design and build the systems that power Kota's Investments products; pensions, retirement savings and Spend: contributions, onboarding, provider integrations, employer-facing configuration, card issuing and wallet provisioning
Own technical architecture for the Investments stream, integrating with external pension and savings providers as well as payment and card infrastructure (Stripe)
Contribute to frontend code (React + TypeScript) when a feature calls for it
Join client calls where it helps you understand or explain a problem, and proactively shape the roadmap rather than just picking up tickets
Use AI actively in your day-to-day work, for building, reviewing and speeding up how you ship
Contribute to code reviews and technical planning, and keep the systems you own stable and observable
Help shape how the Investments team works as it grows

What We're Looking For

6+ years building backend systems in production (.NET 10, PostgreSQL, Azure/AWS), comfortable picking up frontend (React/TypeScript) when needed
Experience designing and maintaining integrations with third-party APIs
Strong understanding of data modelling, event-driven patterns, and building for correctness and auditability
A clear communicator who can talk to engineers and customers, and knows which version to use with which audience
A product mindset and a bias to bring ideas, not just execute them, proactively adding to the roadmap
You take real ownership, if a request from a client or lead doesn't match your own understanding of the problem, you say so rather than building to spec anyway
You think carefully about reliability, security and compliance, and are comfortable with ambiguity and ownership in a fast-growing startup
AI-forward mindset, we use AI daily to build and improve our systems and expect you to as well

Why join us?

Technically interesting problem - pension infrastructure is genuinely complex: multi-provider, multi-market and largely unmodernised
Modern stack - .NET 10, PostgreSQL, React, TypeScript, Next.js, Azure/AWS, event-driven
Agency - we hire people and trust them. You'll own meaningful parts of the system end to end
Customer proximity - you'll see the impact of what you build, and hear directly from the people using it
High-quality culture - we care about clean design and thoughtful engineering
Impact from day one - we're a small, focused team. What you build ships fast and matters
AI-first - we invest heavily in AI tooling and token usage. We're not precious about the spend, if it helps you build better or faster, use it

Our hiring process

Introductory call (30 mins): a casual chat with one or two of our product team
Technical interview (90 mins): a collaborative, open-book session with two engineers, working through a real-world problem together
Call with founders (30 mins): we'll share our vision and hear your thoughts
Final response: we'll follow up promptly with next steps

Kota Benefits

Health insurance via Kota
Workplace pension with matched contributions up to 5% via Kota
WFH stipend to support your home office setup
Generous paid time off, work hard and take the time you need
Access to office space in Dublin or a co-working space, wherever you're based
Flexible working hours, we're remote-first with some fixed hours for team alignment

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: AI Developer
jobs.description:
We are looking for an AI Developer to our team in Espoo or Tampere!

This permanent position is about building AI solutions that do real work in our customers' processes, and making them reliable enough to run in production. The role can be tailored according to your preferences and skills: some of our developers spend more time with the customer shaping which processes are worth automating, others go deeper into the orchestration, evaluation and operations side.

You will join a team of experienced professionals from different areas of software expertise. We work in a hybrid mode, but in this role we expect strong presence in Espoo or Tampere.

Naturally, you will have access to modern tools and strong co-operation with your colleagues.

One of our strengths in career development is our diverse range of clients and various projects in different fields. That enables us to offer versatile opportunities for our employees. At Etteplan, we are concentrating on helping our customers especially in industrial system digitalization, which means the agents you build will touch engineering data, technical documentation, service processes and industrial operations, not just chat interfaces. Many of these customers have strict requirements about where their data may go, so running models locally and on-premises is a direction we are actively building capability in.

As an AI Developer at Etteplan, the role would include (but not be limited to):

Map customer processes into agentic workflows: decide what the agent decides, what a tool does, and where a human stays in the loop
Design and build tool-using agents that plan and execute multi-step tasks, including task decomposition, state and memory handling, and controlled autonomy
Build and maintain the tool and integration layer: tool contracts and schemas, structured input and output, validation and retries, and connections to customer APIs, databases, document repositories and operational systems
Build the application around the agent, from the user-facing interface to backend services, databases, authentication and deployment pipelines
Deploy solutions where the customer needs them, whether that is Azure, another cloud, the customer's own servers, or an on-premises environment running local models
Implement the controls that make AI acceptable in an industrial context: permissions, policy checks, audit logs, and correct handling of confidential customer data
Stay up to date with the fast-moving AI tooling landscape and help us decide what is production-ready and what is not

We are looking for a person who has:

Proven experience building LLM-based applications that reached production, not only prototypes and demos
Hands-on experience with agent frameworks and orchestration, for example LangGraph, LangChain, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, Semantic Kernel, Copilot Studio, n8n or equivalent
Experience working against AI and LLM APIs from several providers, including tool and function calling, structured output, and MCP (Model Context Protocol) or comparable ways of exposing tools and data to an agent
Full-stack capability: you can take a solution from user interface through backend services, databases, APIs and authentication to a running deployment
Docker and containers as part of your normal way of working, together with CI/CD and monitoring
Familiarity with cloud platforms, Azure in particular, and with AWS or Google Cloud as a plus
Ability to work directly with customers, translate ambiguous requirements into something buildable, and explain trade-offs in plain language
Working proficiency in English; Finnish is a strong advantage in customer work

We appreciate also, if you are familiar with:

Local and self-hosted inference
Efficient handling of large volumes of data
Evaluation of non-deterministic systems
Industrial context: manufacturing, energy, machinery, medical devices or defence and security, and the systems around them such as MES, PLM, ERP, IIoT or technical documentation and CCMS environments

The salary range is quite wide, reflecting our openness to both earlier‑career and more experienced professionals. What matters most to us is finding the right competencies and fit and aligning the role and compensation to match.

jobs.description:
Imagine a world with zero vehicle accidents, zero vehicle emissions, and wireless vehicle connectivity all around us. Every day, we move closer to making that world a reality. Aptiv’s passionate team of engineers and developers creates advanced safety systems, high-performance electrification solutions and data connectivity solutions so that automakers can bring advanced capabilities to more people around the globe. This is how we enable sustainable mobility and help to prevent accidents caused by human error.

Want to join us?

Factory Information Systems (FIS) is Aptiv’s developed and owned system used to track and monitor manufacturing processes. We are looking for an IT engineer who will be part of Global Factory Information Systems team and will operate globally.

Your Role

Software development according to given quality standards and within given time
Develop in-depth understanding of manufacturing process
Actively participate in the investigation, design and deployment of a global Factory Information System
Act as technical subject matter expert to support ongoing operations. Participate in incident management process and problem resolution. Coordinate new system deployments globally
Provide technical consultation to production sites in the area of application functionality, configuration and interfacing capabilities
Assist production sites in connecting new equipment to Factory Information System

Your Background

B.S. or Master degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or Technology
At least 4 years of experience in IT area: software development for mission critical, transactional systems processing high volume of data
Ability to develop software in object oriented languages (C#, VB.NET, etc.) and scripting languages (TCL, Python, BASH, etc.).
Red Hat Linux based applications environment.
MariaDB (MySQL) database knowledge.
English level B2 or higher

Why join us?

You can grow at Aptiv. Aptiv provides an inclusive work environment where all individuals can grow and develop, regardless of gender, ethnicity or beliefs.
You can have an impact. Safety is a core Aptiv value; we want a safer world for us and our children, one with: Zero fatalities, Zero injuries, Zero accidents.
You have support. We ensure you have the resources and support you need to take care of your family and your physical and mental health with a competitive health insurance package.
